title: Ready or Not 2: Here I Come

direction.comments: The direction on a macroscale is typical of a studio horror-comedy; The microscale is what you would expect from a studio horror-comedy; The storytelling is pretty straightforward; The tension is pretty artificial, but it does work in making the movie entertaining

performance.comments: Holds her own well as the lead and shows a decent range of emotion, but it just feels like she is there for the paycheck; does not really have the best chemistry with the cast, epsecially Kathryn Newton
I honestly felt her character was pretty annoying and didn't really have any chemistry with Weaving
Plays the villain decently well, but really just feels pretty formulaic
Kinda just plays this stoic character who is somewhat of a overseer/judge for the whole game

cast.comments: Just a cast of people filling in roles for a formulaic studio horror-comedy; the chemistry is a bit forced

story.comments: The concept continues where the first movie left off and is a larger game of survival, though it is hard to say how it compares since I did not watch the first movie; The plot structure is linear and straightforward; The character writing is shallow, which is what you would expect from a studio horror-comedy

screenplay.comments: The dialogue is fine and typical of a studio film; The humor is present, but they try a little too hard to be funny; The foreshadowing kind of gives the movie away and makes it feel safe

score.comments: The score helps establish the tone and tension

sound.comments: The sound helps establish the tone and tension and makes this movie feel like it has a larger budget

visual_effects.comments: The visual effects are standard for a studio horror-comedy and are nothing groundbreaking

production_design.comments: The production design sets the movie in a grand mansion to continue where the last movie left off

makeup.comments: The makeup shows the gore and blood to make this movie feel like a horror movie

costumes.comments: The costumes show the regal nature of the movie and the after-effects of the first movie

review.pacing: The pacing is decent, though it does move quickly in certain moments
review.climax: The climax is entertaining and is definitely the best part of the movie
review.tone: The tone is very much that of a studio horror-comedy that feels safe overall
review.final_notes: I saw the world premiere at SXSW
review.overall: Overall, Ready or Not 2 feels like a generic studio horror-comedy that is meant to provide a good time, but it does not leave you thinking about what you watched; I have not seen the first movie, but it feels like this movie was a cash grab considering it feels very safe and does not have any of the indie charm of the first film
